name: flowvik-node-react
description: FlowVik ManyChat-like Instagram automation SaaS - Node.js + React + Neon PostgreSQL

scripts.dev: concurrently -n SERVER,CLIENT -c auto "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.start: concurrently -n SERVER,CLIENT -c auto "npm run start -w server" "npm run preview -w client -- --host 0.0.0.0"
scripts.check: node --check server/src/index.js && node --check server/src/db.js && node --check server/src/meta.js && node --check server/src/automation.js && node --check server/src/security.js
